AC2.sampling_note: SCAN's acceleration gate (checkDynamicFeasibility) samples every max(0.01, min(0.05, duration/50)) s, i.e. 0.05 s for durations of 2.5 s or more, while t < duration + 1e-6 (planner_manager.cpp:460-464), so its last sample usually falls before the trajectory end. The harness maximum (1001 samples including t = duration) can therefore exceed 1.5 m/s^2 for accepted original-build trajectories.

boundary_notes: Follow-up offsets 0.3 s and 0.6 s are a stress schedule, not the live trigger. In EXEC_TRAJ the live FSM replans once the robot is 1.0 m from the current trajectory start (scan_replan_fsm.cpp:893, fsm.thresh_replan 1.0 in planner.yaml) or when checkCollisionCallback finds a collision (scan_replan_fsm.cpp:1083); new targets and routes also trigger a replan.

SCAN's own collision checks cover only the first two thirds of a trajectory (bspline_optimizer.cpp:1017-1018 after rebound optimization, 1115-1116 after refinement), and reboundReplan has no final collision check (planner_manager.cpp:298 checks dynamic feasibility only). AC4 therefore samples every accepted trajectory independently over its full duration, every 0.01 s from t = 0.

SCAN's acceleration gate (checkDynamicFeasibility) samples every max(0.01, min(0.05, duration/50)) s, i.e. 0.05 s for durations of 2.5 s or more, while t < duration + 1e-6 (planner_manager.cpp:460-464), so its last sample usually falls before the trajectory end. The harness maximum (1001 samples including t = duration) can therefore exceed 1.5 m/s^2 for accepted original-build trajectories.

thresholds_amendments.reason: The D8 per-call pairing is not meaningful: after call 0 the two builds' trajectories diverge, so call i of each build starts from a different state. Call 0 is already judged by the single-call rule, where the fix's known endpoint shift is 1-2.5 cm. The same local Humble preview (not evidence) had 7 follow-up calls over original + 0.01 m: call 0 shifts of 1.0-1.3 cm, and call 1 at x = -1.09 and -1.10 m ended 0.001 and 0.005 m from the target in the original but 0.077 and 0.081 m in the candidate. Follow-up completion stays judged by AC6; final position is judged by the Isaac arrival checks (AC7).
